howto.what: Claude 会用「Presenter Mode Deck」模板生成幻灯片:每页附带150–300字的演讲者备注,右下角有工具条,按 T 可切换5套主题(默认 tokyo-night),按 S 打开含当前页、下一页、讲稿、计时的四张提词卡弹窗。
howto.when: 当你请 Claude 创作演讲用演示文稿、需要带提词备注或演讲者视图时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个演讲者模式的 deck,每页带提词备注。

say.text: 给这套幻灯片加上可切换主题和提词器。

howto.what_en: Claude creates slides with the Presenter Mode Deck template: per-page speaker notes, a bottom-right toolbar (T switches 5 themes, S opens a popup showing current/next slide, script, and timer).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to create a presentation with speaker notes or a teleprompter mode.

say_en.text: Create a presenter-mode deck with speaker notes on each slide.
say_en.note: Generates a slide template with notes.

say_en.text: Use the Presenter Mode Deck template for my product launch slides.
